title: Apache Axis: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 18 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. The severity score is critical (9.8).
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.

category.label: Other software

category.doThis: Find out if you use it. If you do, apply the vendor's fix.

summary: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS).
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Nov 21, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
